description:
Sets the background color to the current cell range with the previously created color object.
Sets 'No Fill' when the previously created color object is 'No Fill' or null.

params.description: The color object which specifies the color to be set to the background in the cell / cell range. Pass 'No Fill' or null to clear the background color.
params.name: color

returns.description: returns true if the fill color was set successfully.
